mapper.select: SELECT p.tenant_id AS tenantId, p.id AS projectId, p.version AS projectVersion, t.id AS projectTaskId, t.version AS projectTaskVersion, t.source_definition_id AS sourceDefinitionId, c.id AS executionContractId, c.template_task_definition_id AS templateTaskDefinitionId, c.work_binding_type_code AS workBindingTypeCode, c.target_context_code AS targetContextCode, c.target_object_type AS targetObjectType, c.target_object_key AS targetObjectKey, c.binding_parameter_snapshot AS bindingParameterSnapshot, c.source_definition_version AS sourceDefinitionVersion, c.contract_version AS contractVersion, d.template_revision_id AS templateRevisionId, r.revision_no AS templateRevisionNo FROM proj_project p JOIN proj_project_task t ON t.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND t.project_id = p.id AND t.deleted = b'0' JOIN proj_project_task_execution_contract c ON c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND c.project_task_id = t.id AND c.current_marker = 1 AND c.effective_to IS NULL AND c.deleted = b'0' JOIN proj_project_template_task_definition d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.id = c.template_task_definition_id AND d.deleted = b'0' JOIN proj_project_template_revision r ON r.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND r.id = d.template_revision_id AND r.deleted = b'0' WHERE p.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND p.id = #{query.projectId} AND p.deleted = b'0' AND c.work_binding_type_code = #{query.workBindingTypeCode} AND c.target_context_code = #{query.targetContextCode} AND c.target_object_type = #{query.targetObjectType} AND c.target_object_key = #{query.targetObjectKey}

SELECT * FROM proj_project_task_execution_contract WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_task_id = #{query.projectTaskId} AND current_marker = 1 AND effective_to IS NULL AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT d.id AS templateTaskDefinitionId, d.template_revision_id AS templateRevisionId, r.revision_no AS templateRevisionNo FROM proj_project_template_task_definition d JOIN proj_project_template_revision r ON r.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND r.id = d.template_revision_id AND r.deleted = b'0' WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND d.id = #{query.templateTaskDefinitionId} AND d.deleted = b'0'

SELECT p.tenant_id AS tenantId, p.id AS projectId, t.id AS projectTaskId, t.task_code AS taskCode, t.version AS projectTaskVersion, t.satisfaction_timing AS satisfactionTiming, t.acc_satisfaction_template_id AS templateId, t.template_revision_id AS templateRevisionId, t.template_version AS templateVersion, t.satisfaction_rule_version AS ruleVersion, t.satisfaction_threshold AS threshold, COALESCE(a.assignee_user_id, p.manager_id) AS currentAssigneeUserId FROM proj_project p JOIN proj_project_task t ON t.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND t.project_id = p.id AND t.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN proj_project_task_assignment a ON a.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND a.project_task_id = t.id AND a.current_marker = 1 AND a.effective_to IS NULL AND a.deleted = b'0' WHERE p.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND p.id = #{query.projectId} AND t.id = #{query.projectTaskId} AND p.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.tenant_id AS tenantId, p.id AS projectId, t.id AS projectTaskId, t.task_code AS taskCode, t.version AS projectTaskVersion, t.satisfaction_timing AS satisfactionTiming, t.acc_satisfaction_template_id AS templateId, t.template_revision_id AS templateRevisionId, t.template_version AS templateVersion, t.satisfaction_rule_version AS ruleVersion, t.satisfaction_threshold AS threshold, a.assignee_user_id AS currentAssigneeUserId FROM proj_project p JOIN proj_project_task t ON t.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND t.project_id = p.id AND t.task_code = 'T-SAT-SURVEY' AND t.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN proj_project_task_assignment a ON a.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND a.project_task_id = t.id AND a.current_marker = 1 AND a.effective_to IS NULL AND a.deleted = b'0' WHERE p.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND p.id = #{query.projectId} AND p.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
